title: Comparison of body composition data derived from the bodyplethysmography apparatus BodPod and conventional dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry
summary: The measurement of fat mass and fat-free mass is important for specific diagnostic questions in pediatrics. This is the case for dose calculation of chemotherapeutic agents in very obese children with cancer, but also for the judgement of the nutritional status in chronically ill children. Traditionally, dual energy X-ray absorption is the gold standard for this measurement. However, it is associated with radiation, which is absent in bodyplethysmography.

interventions.name: Measurement of body fat by BodPod and DXA (dual x-ray absorptiometry)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age > 3 years
- Ability to sit for a while
- No infusion tube
- Signed consent form for this study
Exclusion criteria:
none
